name: Auroora Group Oyj
summary: Auroora Group Plc is a serial acquirer that builds long-term and profitable growth through acquisitions and operational development. It acts as a permanent owner for SME's and develops the companies it owns as part of a decentralized and entrepreneurially managed group structure. The company operates through the following business segments: Electrification and Automation, Clean Water and Environmental Technology, and Industrial Products and Services. The Electrification & Automation segment includes energy efficient electrical and automation products and solutions. The Clean Water & Environmental Technology segment includes technology and services for water purification and wastewater treatment, circular economy solutions and environmental technology services. The Industrial Products & Services segment includes specialized industrial products, maintenance and technical services for manufacturing, energy and infrastructure customers aiming for sustainable supply chains and solutions that enhance industrial efficiency and sustainability. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Tampere, Finland.
